fix.durable_report: main() writes <candidate>/formal_run_report.json with the canonical sorted-key JSON + newline (views.write_json) before emitting anything; the file exists for every completed CLI run and is the evidence contract
fix.shutdown_flush_guard: main() is wrapped in try/finally quiet_stdout(): if the final flush of a blocked stream raises, sys.stdout is replaced by a no-op stream so interpreter shutdown cannot turn a successful run into exit code 120

post_run_fix.pre_fix_reproduction: with sys.stdout patched to raise BlockingIOError, a resume run on the completed candidate raised BlockingIOError and wrote no formal_run_report.json; the same wrapper also exited 120 from the shutdown flush before the quiet_stdout guard

post_run_fix.root_cause: after every one of the 45 fits succeeded, formal.py main() wrote the final JSON report to sys.stdout; under a full/non-blocking stdout pipe that write raised BlockingIOError: [Errno 11] write could not complete without blocking, so the driver exited 1 and a completed matrix looked failed to callers/automation. CPython also exits 120 when flushing sys.stdout fails at shutdown, so catching only the in-main write was not sufficient.
